items.title: WM Q2 Deep Dive: Improving Margins and Integration Progress Offset Softer Volume Trends
items.summary: Waste management services provider Waste Management (NYSE:WM) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4% year on year to $6.68 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $26.38 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.02 per share was 2.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
